propositions: rebar doctor scan_locks reports only four lock legs (tickets-write-fcntl, tickets-write-mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) and omits compact-worker.lock despite it being a stamped advisory lock in the canonical .rebar/ directory

a compaction worker that dies between acquiring and releasing its lock leaves a stamped lock file invisible to rebar doctor, breaking observability of the most likely lock to be held by a detached background process
compact-worker.lock uses the same O_EXCL stamped-file shape and staleness arbitration (lock_owner.stamped_file_is_stale) as enrich-drain.lock, enabling reuse of the _existence_report helper
adding the compact-worker leg to scan_locks requires registering it in the doctor output schema (doctor.schema.json) and extending test coverage to verify free/held/stale states
